lessons.title: The Job That Changed Everything
lessons.context: A story about a career decision, using subordinate and relative clauses.

paragraphs.de: Markus war zufrieden mit seinem Leben, obwohl er wenig Geld verdiente.
paragraphs.en: Markus was satisfied with his life, although he earned little money.

paragraphs.de: Eines Tages bekam er ein Angebot von einer Firma, deren Ruf exzellent war.
paragraphs.en: One day he received an offer from a company whose reputation was excellent.

paragraphs.de: Er musste sich entscheiden, ob er seinen sicheren Job aufgeben sollte.
paragraphs.en: He had to decide whether to give up his secure job.

paragraphs.de: Wenn er die neue Stelle annehmen würde, müsste er in eine andere Stadt ziehen.
paragraphs.en: If he accepted the new position, he would have to move to another city.

paragraphs.de: Nach langem Überlegen entschied er sich für das Abenteuer, weil er wusste, dass er es später bereuen würde, wenn er es nicht versuchte.
paragraphs.en: After long deliberation, he decided on the adventure, because he knew he would regret it later if he didn't try.

questions.question: How did Markus feel about his life at the start?
What was special about the company that made the offer?
What would Markus have to do if he took the job?
Why did he choose the adventure?
options: He knew he would regret not trying

lessons.title: A Village That No Longer Exists
lessons.titleNative: Ein Dorf, das es nicht mehr gibt
lessons.context: A narrative in the Präteritum about a place that vanished.

paragraphs.de: Es gab einmal ein kleines Dorf, das mitten im Wald lag.
paragraphs.en: There was once a small village that lay in the middle of the forest.

paragraphs.de: Die Menschen, die dort lebten, kannten sich alle sehr gut.
paragraphs.en: The people who lived there all knew each other very well.

paragraphs.de: Wegen einer großen Überschwemmung mussten die Bewohner ihre Häuser verlassen.
paragraphs.en: Because of a major flood, the residents had to leave their houses.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl viele Jahre vergangen sind, erinnern sich die alten Bewohner noch an ihr Dorf.
paragraphs.en: Although many years have passed, the old residents still remember their village.

paragraphs.de: Wenn man heute dorthin reist, findet man nur noch Bäume und Stille.
paragraphs.en: If you travel there today, you find only trees and silence.

questions.question: Where was the village located?
options: In the middle of the forest

questions.question: What did the residents have in common?
options: They all knew each other very well

questions.question: Why did they have to leave?
What does one find there today?

lessons.title: The Colleague I Trust
lessons.context: A short workplace story using dative and genitive relative clauses.

paragraphs.de: Sarah ist die Kollegin, der ich am meisten vertraue.
paragraphs.en: Sarah is the colleague I trust the most.

paragraphs.de: Sie ist die Frau, deren Ideen immer die besten Ergebnisse bringen.
paragraphs.en: She is the woman whose ideas always bring the best results.

paragraphs.de: Als wir ein Problem hatten, wusste sie sofort, dass sie helfen konnte.
paragraphs.en: When we had a problem, she immediately knew that she could help.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl sie sehr beschäftigt war, nahm sie sich Zeit für uns.
paragraphs.en: Although she was very busy, she took time for us.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich einen Rat brauche, frage ich immer sie, weil ich weiß, dass sie ehrlich antwortet.
paragraphs.en: Whenever I need advice, I always ask her, because I know she answers honestly.

questions.question: Who does the writer trust the most?
What is special about Sarah's ideas?
options: They always bring the best results

questions.question: What did Sarah do despite being busy?
Why does the writer always ask Sarah for advice?
options: Because no one else is available

lessons.title: If I Had Known
lessons.context: A reflective story using Konjunktiv II throughout.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich damals mehr Mut gehabt hätte, hätte ich die Reise gemacht.
paragraphs.en: If I had had more courage back then, I would have made the trip.

paragraphs.de: Ich hätte gern die Welt gesehen, aber ich hatte Angst, allein zu reisen.
paragraphs.en: I would have liked to see the world, but I was afraid to travel alone.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich meine Freunde damals gefragt hätte, wären sie wahrscheinlich mitgekommen.
paragraphs.en: If I had asked my friends back then, they probably would have come along.

paragraphs.de: Jetzt, Jahre später, denke ich oft daran, was hätte sein können.
paragraphs.en: Now, years later, I often think about what could have been.

paragraphs.de: Es wäre nie zu spät, es noch einmal zu versuchen, also plane ich für nächstes Jahr eine neue Reise.
paragraphs.en: It would never be too late to try again, so I am planning a new trip for next year.

questions.question: What does the writer regret about the past?
options: Not having the courage to travel

questions.question: Why didn't the writer travel back then?
What does the writer think would have happened if they had asked friends?
options: The friends probably would have come along

questions.question: What is the writer planning now?
options: A new trip for next year

lessons.title: The Apartment Whose View Is Unforgettable
lessons.titleNative: Die Wohnung, deren Aussicht unvergesslich ist
lessons.context: A descriptive story using genitive and adjective endings.

paragraphs.de: Wir fanden eine kleine Wohnung, deren Aussicht auf die Berge unvergesslich war.
paragraphs.en: We found a small apartment whose view of the mountains was unforgettable.

paragraphs.de: Trotz des hohen Preises entschieden wir uns dafür, dort zu leben.
paragraphs.en: Despite the high price, we decided to live there.

paragraphs.de: Jeden Morgen, während wir unseren Kaffee tranken, sahen wir die Sonne über den Bergen aufgehen.
paragraphs.en: Every morning, while we drank our coffee, we watched the sun rise over the mountains.

paragraphs.de: Der Besitzer der Wohnung, ein freundlicher älterer Mann, half uns oft mit kleinen Reparaturen.
paragraphs.en: The owner of the apartment, a friendly older man, often helped us with small repairs.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl wir inzwischen umgezogen sind, denken wir noch oft an diese wunderbare Zeit.
paragraphs.en: Although we have since moved, we still often think about that wonderful time.

questions.question: What was special about the apartment?
options: Its view of the mountains was unforgettable

questions.question: Why did they still decide to live there?
What did they watch every morning?
Who was the owner of the apartment?

lessons.title: A Letter to My Younger Self
lessons.titleNative: Ein Brief an mein jüngeres Ich
lessons.context: A reflective letter using subordinate clauses and Konjunktiv II.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich meinem jüngeren Ich einen Brief schreiben könnte, würde ich ihm sagen, dass alles gut wird.
paragraphs.en: If I could write a letter to my younger self, I would tell him that everything will be fine.

paragraphs.de: Ich würde ihm sagen, dass er sich weniger Sorgen machen sollte, weil die meisten Probleme sich lösen.
paragraphs.en: I would tell him that he should worry less, because most problems solve themselves.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl der Weg manchmal schwer war, hat er ihn zu der Person gemacht, die er heute ist.
paragraphs.en: Although the path was sometimes hard, it made him into the person he is today.

paragraphs.de: Ich würde ihm auch raten, dass er mutiger sein sollte, wenn es um wichtige Entscheidungen geht.
paragraphs.en: I would also advise him to be braver when it comes to important decisions.

paragraphs.de: Am Ende würde ich ihm danken, dass er nie aufgegeben hat.
paragraphs.en: In the end, I would thank him for never giving up.

questions.question: What would the writer tell their younger self?
Why should the younger self worry less?
What did the difficult path do for the writer?
options: Made him the person he is today

questions.question: What would the writer thank their younger self for?

lessons.title: The Meeting That Almost Didn't Happen
lessons.titleNative: Das Treffen, das fast nicht stattgefunden hätte
lessons.context: A story combining several B1 grammar points in a workplace setting.

paragraphs.de: Das Treffen, das für Montag geplant war, wäre fast abgesagt worden.
paragraphs.en: The meeting that was planned for Monday almost got cancelled.

paragraphs.de: Wegen eines technischen Problems konnten wir zuerst keine Verbindung herstellen.
paragraphs.en: Because of a technical problem, we couldn't establish a connection at first.

paragraphs.de: Der Kollege, dessen Präsentation am wichtigsten war, wartete geduldig, während wir das Problem lösten.
paragraphs.en: The colleague whose presentation was most important waited patiently while we solved the problem.

paragraphs.de: Als die Verbindung endlich funktionierte, begannen wir sofort, obwohl wir schon eine halbe Stunde verloren hatten.
paragraphs.en: When the connection finally worked, we started immediately, although we had already lost half an hour.

paragraphs.de: Am Ende war das Treffen ein großer Erfolg, und niemand erinnerte sich mehr an den schwierigen Anfang.
paragraphs.en: In the end, the meeting was a big success, and no one remembered the difficult start anymore.

questions.question: What almost happened to the meeting?
Why couldn't they connect at first?
What did the colleague with the important presentation do?
How did the meeting end up going?

lessons.title: Whose Idea Was It?
lessons.context: A light story built around genitive relative pronouns and Präteritum narration.

paragraphs.de: Die Idee für das Fest, das jedes Jahr im Park stattfindet, kam von einer Frau, deren Name heute fast vergessen ist.
paragraphs.en: The idea for the festival that takes place every year in the park came from a woman whose name is almost forgotten today.

paragraphs.de: Vor zwanzig Jahren schlug sie vor, dass die Nachbarschaft ein Sommerfest organisieren sollte.
paragraphs.en: Twenty years ago, she suggested that the neighborhood should organize a summer festival.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl viele Leute zuerst skeptisch waren, wurde das Fest schnell sehr beliebt.
paragraphs.en: Although many people were skeptical at first, the festival quickly became very popular.

paragraphs.de: Jedes Jahr kommen Hunderte von Menschen, deren Kinder heute selbst schon erwachsen sind.
paragraphs.en: Every year hundreds of people come, whose children today are already grown up themselves.

paragraphs.de: Wenn man die Bewohner fragt, wer die Idee hatte, erinnert sich kaum noch jemand an ihren Namen.
paragraphs.en: If you ask the residents who had the idea, hardly anyone remembers her name anymore.

questions.question: Who first suggested the idea for the festival?
options: A man from the city council
A woman whose name is almost forgotten

questions.question: How did people react at first?
How long ago did this happen?
What does the passage say about the woman's name today?

lessons.title: A Storm During the Trip
lessons.context: A travel narrative combining während, Präteritum, and Konjunktiv II.

paragraphs.de: Während unserer Reise durch die Berge überraschte uns plötzlich ein starker Sturm.
paragraphs.en: During our trip through the mountains, a strong storm suddenly caught us by surprise.

paragraphs.de: Der Wind war so stark, dass wir kaum weitergehen konnten.
paragraphs.en: The wind was so strong that we could hardly keep walking.

paragraphs.de: Wenn wir gewusst hätten, dass das Wetter so schlecht werden würde, wären wir nicht losgegangen.
paragraphs.en: If we had known the weather would get so bad, we wouldn't have set out.

paragraphs.de: Zum Glück fanden wir eine kleine Hütte, deren Tür zum Glück offen war.
paragraphs.en: Luckily we found a small hut, whose door was fortunately open.

paragraphs.de: Wir blieben dort, bis der Sturm vorbei war, und erzählten uns Geschichten, während wir auf besseres Wetter warteten.
paragraphs.en: We stayed there until the storm was over, telling each other stories while we waited for better weather.

questions.question: What happened during the trip through the mountains?
What would they have done if they had known about the weather?
Where did they find shelter?
What did they do while waiting?

lessons.title: What I Would Change
lessons.context: A capstone reflection combining B1's full grammar range.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich mein Leben noch einmal leben könnte, würde ich vieles anders machen, aber nicht alles.
paragraphs.en: If I could live my life again, I would do many things differently, but not everything.

paragraphs.de: Ich würde mutiger sein und die Chancen nutzen, die ich damals aus Angst verpasst habe.
paragraphs.en: I would be braver and take the opportunities I missed out of fear back then.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl ich einige Fehler bereue, weiß ich, dass sie mich zu der Person gemacht haben, die ich heute bin.
paragraphs.en: Although I regret some mistakes, I know they made me the person I am today.

paragraphs.de: Die Menschen, denen ich in meinem Leben begegnet bin, haben mich mehr geprägt, als ich damals verstand.
paragraphs.en: The people I encountered in my life shaped me more than I understood at the time.

paragraphs.de: Wenn ich einen Rat geben könnte, wäre es dieser: Habe keine Angst vor Veränderung, denn sie bringt oft das Beste in dir hervor.
paragraphs.en: If I could give one piece of advice, it would be this: Don't be afraid of change, because it often brings out the best in you.

questions.question: Would the writer change everything about their life?
What does the writer wish they had been?
What does the writer say about their mistakes?
options: They made him the person he is today

questions.question: What advice does the writer give at the end?
